howToPlay: Maintain a position where you can simultaneously tether to an enemy and a teammate to maximize healing and damage output. Use the dash to escape danger and support allies, and activate your fear-inducing Super to disrupt the opposing team's formation.
gears: Equip SHIELD and HEALTH to increase survivability while tethered. Use GADGET COOLDOWN for more frequent healing dashes or to utilize the beam boost more often.
trait: Glowy is suited for a strategic player who enjoys balanced gameplay that shifts between defensive support and aggressive disruption.
